'''Kyle Fisher''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Columbus tournament (6 January)]] on 6 January 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA Manipulator]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB/Sandwhirls]], according to Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1599">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-columbus-oh-1-6-01d1599/ columbus-oh-1-6-01], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 7 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-columbus-oh-1-6-01d1599/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
